To Approve the September 12, 2022 Planning Commission Meeting Minutes with one amendment. Motion by: Commissioner Nelson Kearns Metro Township Planning Commission – November 14, 2022 – Meeting Summary 2nd by: Commissioner Koester Vote: Commissioner Thomas did not vote, all other commissioners voted in favor. Motion passed. 3) Other Business Items (as needed) Commissioners had a brief discussion regarding a logo, shirts, name plates, and name tags. PUBLIC HEARING Hearings began at – 5:09 p.m. OAM2022-000698 - The Municipal Services District (MSD) planning staff is recommending an ordinance change to be made to the Kearns Municipal Code section 19.15.050. This is a proposed amendment to the setback standards of detached accessory dwelling units, allowing existing accessory buildings to be converted to detached ADUs if they comply with building code. The amendment also proposes to reduce the rear and side setback for detached ADUs to five (5) feet. Presenter: Morgan Julian (Motion/Voting) Greater Salt Lake Municipal Services District Planning and Development Planner Morgan Julian provided an analysis of the recommended ordinance change. Commissioners and staff had a brief discussion proposing formatting and divide standards, purpose of six foot minimum from primary dwelling, and firewalls. Commissioner Taylor motioned to open the public hearing, Commissioner Nelson seconded that motion. PUBLIC PORTION OF HEARING OPENED Speaker # 1: Name: Cheryle Hatch Address: 5445 South Rockford Street Comments: Ms. Hatch said according to ADU’s the existing dwellings conversion, is there a consideration to water and sewer and part of the building code. Additional needs are a health and safety issue. Mr. Bracken said yes, they have come up with an arrangement with Kearns Improvement District and a process in advance to ensure they have enough water. They are already allowed in the current code. Ms. Hatch asked about existing and new ADU’s. Mr. Bracken said if they are illegal, they must come into compliance. Speaker # 2: Kearns Community Council Name: Roger Snow Address: 5977 South Parkwood Drive Comments: Message from Mr. Snow to Commissioner Taylor: Mr. Snow said the Kearns Community Council gives a favorable recommendation to the ADU Ordinance change. Commissioner Koester motioned to close the public hearing, Commissioner Nelson seconded that motion. PUBLIC PORTION OF HEARING CLOSED Kearns Metro Township Planning Commission – November 14, 2022 – Meeting Summary Motion: To recommend approval of file #OAM2022-000698 that the Municipal Services District (MSD) planning staff is recommending an ordinance change to be made to the Kearns Municipal Code section 19.15.050. This is a proposed amendment to the setback standards of detached accessory dwelling units, allowing existing accessory buildings to be converted to detached ADUs if they comply with building code. The amendment also proposes to reduce the rear and side setback for detached ADUs to five (5) feet to the Kearns Metro Township Council as presented.
